messages:
ellen_cs: Ok team — greenfield (acct GF-314) onboarding: customer asks Dedicated pool live + autoscale by EOW. proposing initial quota: 24 GPU slots (8x p3.2xlarge equiv) with burst headroom to 36 for first 48h. Thoughts?
priya_se: 24 sounds reasonable given their projected TPS. recommend: target batch_size=8, kv_cache=enabled, token_limit=2048. will include a quantized model variant in rollout to save cost.
jorge_oncall: +1. Suggest autoscale policy: 'aggressive' for first 24h (scale_step=4 slots / 60s) then relax to steady (scale_step=2 slots / 5m). also need runbook link and escalation path.
ellen_cs: agreed. runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/dedicated-bringup (see "priming & burst policies"). quick loadtest we plan to run:
```
# run from ops bastion against sandbox pool
loadtest --concurrency 48 --duration 30m --model redwood-alpha-quant --rate 120/s --endpoint https://dedicated.greenfield.redwood/api/generate
```
liam_prod: heads-up on renewal: GF is on a 12mo reserved trial. if we observe >20% p95 latency regression or >2% error rate during priming, pause trial and trigger remediation + customer comms. also need a 60m enablement session for their infra/app team.
priya_se: i'll take enablement — can run Tue 10am PT. i'll cover warmup priming, request shaping, SDK best practices and sample scripts.
capacity-bot: Pool allocation complete: pool-id gf-reserved-1815 allocated 24 -> 36 burst. eviction window ETA: 7 days. (trace: #alloc-9f7b)
jorge_oncall: please add synthetic SLO monitors: p50 < 220ms, p95 < 450ms, error_rate < 1.5% for the pool. i'll configure alerts to page on breach and post to #eng-oncall.
ellen_cs: action items: (1) priya -> enablement Tue 10am PT; (2) priya -> push quantized variant + batch config to greenfield sandbox; (3) jorge -> set autoscale + SLO alerts + runbook links; (4) liam -> prepare renewal-risk playbook + customer comms template; (5) ops -> execute loadtest Tue 11am PT (post-workshop). i'll update GF-314 ticket with config snippets. :thumbsup: 
liam_prod: i'll draft the renewal play and comms and share in GF-314.
priya_se: warmup priming snippet i'll include in ticket:
```
for i in {1..8}; do curl -s -X POST https://dedicated.greenfield.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":16}' & done
```
ellen_cs: perfect — closing loop after runbook link + ticket updated. ping if anything changes. :raised_hands:
